notes.title: Playtest 2: June 14 - June 16
notes.notes: [p][/p][h1][b]Strikers Club Playtest 2 (v0.30.1)[/b][/h1][h2][b]Summary[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Playtest servers will be open from now until 16 June 2025 5:00 PM CET[/p][/*][*][p]No new invites are sent [b]but[/b] we have enabled friend invites: Existing testers can [b]invite up to 3 friends.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Goalie has been reworked completely[/p][/*][*][p]Added a dribble indicator and offside indicator[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced kick and dribble spamming[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Patch notes[/b][/h2][h3][b]Goalie rework[/b][/h3][list][*][p]We've remade all goalie animations to have more weight and satisfying flow to them,[/p][/*][*][p]We've made goalie jumps predictive in various scenarios: Pick the right direction and timing and you'll catch it,[/p][/*][*][p]Added more goalie dive states like an upwards forward jump based on the predictive system,[/p][/*][*][p]The camera has been reworked for goalies to pan less abruptly and keep a good overview of the play,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues related to jumping backwards as a goalie,[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Dribble indicator[/b][/h3][p]We've added an indicator below your feet that shows up when the ball gets close to explain the dribbling system [/p][list][*][p]Dribbles go in the direction of your movement, the indicator shows this to get people used to the system,[/p][/*][*][p]We'll add a toggle for it in the future for players who are familiar with the system,[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added topspin and backspin, flicking up/down when shooting the ball adds new effects to the ball[/p][list][*][p]The crosshair while kicking the ball now shows your flick input[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added the double touch rule for free kick, corners, throw-ins (only activates with at least 4 people per side)[/p][/*][*][p]Added an offside indicator which shows up above your charge bars when touching the ball would cause offside[/p][/*][*][p]Added a stumble mechanic: If you get tackled but the slide tackle has low momentum, you stumble instead of falling over[/p][/*][*][p]Added a very short cooldown to hard kicks so they cannot be abused[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased the cooldown on dribbles to encourage more tactical rhythmic play[/p][/*][*][p]Goalie now has a "pick up ball" prompt when they're able to pick it up[/p][list][*][p]We plan to add a toggle in the custom game rulesets so you can force it off for everyone[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Adjusted the ball trail at high speeds for improved visibility and flair[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Audio[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added crowd reactions to goalie catches[/p][/*][*][p]Created new ball hit sounds[/p][/*][*][p]Added more voice types preparing for customization[/p][/*][*][p]Added jump sounds[/p][/*][*][p]Added subtle effects to sprinting[/p][/*][*][p]The end of match crowd cheering now pauses when entering a time-pausing state[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiple issues related to sound direction towards the player[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Animations[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added more 45 degree dribbling animations[/p][/*][*][p]Improved our 'closest foot' system for dribble animations[/p][/*][*][p]Added a dribble chaining system for a more natural dribble flow (experimental)[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Made movement pivots smoother[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several t-poses[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed 8 second goalie hold rule kicking in even during a dropkick state[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed instant stamina regeneration bug after switching position several times[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a broken sprint state where it would use stamina without sprinting occasionally[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the chatbox closing when you're teleported as a single goalie[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed kick charge breaking sometimes when client & server disagreed on timings[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several sounds not being affected by the volume slider[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Media[/b][/h2][p]Once again we'd appreciate it if you kept media of the game restricted to this Discord only and no livestreaming! [/p][p][/p][h2][b]Wishlisting[/b][/h2][p]Don't forget to wishlist the game on Steam! It tells their algorithm to show the game to more potential testers and players! [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1952920/Strikers_Club/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Providing Feedback[/b][/h2][p]Please make sure to participate and post in [url="https://discord.strikersclub.gg"]Discord [/url]when providing feedback! We're still experimenting with a lot of mechanics and features so your feedback has a real and direct influence on the direction and development of the game. Thank you! [/p]
